hints.text: One of these factors is very close to a round number. A round number makes mental multiplication much easier.
Think of $49$ as $50 - 1$. Find $25 \times 50$, then take away the one extra group of $25$ you counted.

explanation: Rewrite $49$ as $50 - 1$, because multiplying by $50$ is much easier than multiplying by $49$.
Multiply by the round number: $25 \times 50 = 1250$, which is half of $25 \times 100$.
That counted one group of $25$ too many, so subtract it: $1250 - 25 = 1225$, and $25 \times 49 = 1225$.
